title: Very dishonest listing- these do NOT weigh 1/2 lb!
text:
Very dishonest listing- these do NOT weigh 1/2 lb!. This was supposed to be 1/2 lb of silver which is why I got it but then I get it and it's a measly 1.2 oz HOLLOW tiny ornament! If you look at the 2nd picture- it was just over half a pound if you weigh the packaging with it but in the listing title, it flat out says the ornament weighs this, not that it's the shipping weight.

Very horrible listing practices and false advertising here! Extremely high priced for a tiny hollow 1.2 oz ornament!
